user.title: Battery Controller
user.description: Configure your home battery for cost optimization. Add battery systems and PV arrays via the integration page after setup.

data_description.price_sensor: Sensor with electricity price forecast attributes (Nordpool, ENTSO-E, or Dynamic Energy Contract Calculator). The optimizer needs future price data to schedule charge and discharge.

data.feed_in_price_sensor: Feed-in price sensor (if different from buy price)
data.power_consumption_sensors: Grid import power sensors (W, e.g. DSMR — for real-time balance)
data.power_production_sensors: Grid export power sensors (W, e.g. DSMR — for real-time balance)

data_description.feed_in_price_sensor: Optional separate sensor for the export/feed-in price. If absent, the fixed feed-in price below is used.
data_description.power_consumption_sensors: Sum of all grid import power sensors. Used by the zero-grid controller for real-time balance (~5 s updates).
data_description.power_production_sensors: Sum of all grid export power sensors. Used by the zero-grid controller for real-time balance (~5 s updates).
data_description.grid_import_sensors: Cumulative kWh drawn from the grid. Household load is not configured but derived: gross = import − export + PV + discharge − charge, using this field, the export and PV fields below, and the energy counters on each battery.
data_description.grid_export_sensors: Cumulative kWh fed back to the grid. Without it, PV that went out to the grid would be counted as consumption the house never drew.
data_description.gross_load_sensors: Only if you have a meter between the inverter and the house. It measures household load directly, so when set the calculation above is skipped entirely. More accurate than summing several meters, and the only workable source when a term is unmeasurable — for example DC-coupled PV with no DC counter. Leave empty otherwise.
data_description.pv_production_sensors: Cumulative kWh from PV inverters — the PV term of that same reconstruction, covering the production that served the house rather than the grid. Without it the integration falls back to its own PV forecast history, which is less accurate.

data_description.fixed_feed_in_price: Fallback sell price when no feed-in price sensor is configured. Also used as the minimum value for arbitrage calculations.
data_description.zero_grid_enabled: Enables real-time battery control to minimize grid exchange. Requires power consumption and production sensors.
data_description.zero_grid_response_time_s: Expected delay from setpoint change to battery response. Limits how frequently setpoints are updated to avoid oscillation.
data_description.max_grid_power_kw: Caps grid import and export power in the optimizer. Set to 0 for no limit.

price_sensor_unavailable.title: Electricity price sensor unavailable
price_sensor_unavailable.description: The price sensor **{sensor}** is unavailable and no historical price model data exists yet. The battery optimizer cannot run without price data. Check that the sensor is working and has forecast attributes.

weather_data_unavailable.title: Weather data unavailable (open-meteo)
weather_data_unavailable.description: The battery controller cannot reach the open-meteo weather API. PV production is assumed to be zero until the connection is restored. Check your internet connection or open-meteo service status.

weather_data_stale.title: Weather data is stale (open-meteo)
weather_data_stale.description: The weather data is {age_hours} hours old and is no longer being refreshed. The PV forecast quality degrades as the data ages. Check your internet connection or open-meteo service status; reload the integration if the problem persists.

user.title: Add Battery
user.description: Configure a battery system. Battery SoC sensor is required. Power sensor improves real-time state detection.

data.name: Name (optional)
data.pv_dc_efficiency: DC coupling efficiency (0–1, for DC-coupled PV on this inverter)
data.high_soc_max_charge_kw: Derated charge power above threshold (kW, optional)
data.low_soc_max_discharge_kw: Derated discharge power below threshold (kW, optional)

data_description.capacity_kwh: Total nameplate capacity of the battery.
data_description.charge_efficiency_curve: Charge efficiency as a function of power. Plain value (e.g. 0.95) for flat efficiency, or power:efficiency pairs (e.g. '0.1:0.73, 0.5:0.91, 5:0.95'). Efficiency is usually much lower at low power, because the inverter's fixed idle loss is paid out of a small flow. See the efficiency curves page in the Battery Controller documentation for measured curves.
data_description.discharge_efficiency_curve: Discharge efficiency as a function of power. Plain value (e.g. 0.95) for flat efficiency, or power:efficiency pairs (e.g. '0.1:0.73, 0.5:0.91, 5:0.95'). Efficiency is usually much lower at low power, because the inverter's fixed idle loss is paid out of a small flow. See the efficiency curves page in the Battery Controller documentation for measured curves.
data_description.min_soc_percent: Optimizer will not discharge below this level. Set slightly above the inverter's hard limit for a safety margin.
data_description.max_soc_percent: Optimizer will not charge above this level. Keeping below 100% extends battery life.
data_description.battery_soc_sensor: Sensor reporting state of charge (0–100 %) or energy in kWh. Required.
data_description.battery_power_sensor: Sensor reporting instantaneous battery power (W or kW). Positive = charging, negative = discharging (this is the opposite sign convention from the power sensors the integration creates, e.g. Battery Setpoint). Optional; improves real-time charge/discharge mode detection.
data_description.battery_energy_charged_sensor: Cumulative kWh charged into this battery. Used to reconstruct gross household load when the consumption sensor measures grid import, because charging from the grid passes the meter and would otherwise be learned as household consumption. If one inverter reports a single counter for several packs, set it on one of them.
data_description.battery_energy_discharged_sensor: Cumulative kWh discharged from this battery. Added back for the same reconstruction, because discharging displaces grid import and would otherwise hide the load it served.
data_description.pv_dc_efficiency: Efficiency from PV panels to the inverter's DC bus (typically 0.97 for MPPT conversion losses only). Only relevant when DC-coupled PV arrays are configured.
data_description.high_soc_charge_threshold_pct: Above this SoC the battery's accepted charge power is reduced. Leave empty if not applicable.
data_description.high_soc_max_charge_kw: Maximum charge power allowed above the high-SoC threshold. Leave empty if not applicable.
data_description.low_soc_discharge_threshold_pct: Below this SoC the battery's delivered discharge power is reduced. Leave empty if not applicable.
data_description.low_soc_max_discharge_kw: Maximum discharge power allowed below the low-SoC threshold. Leave empty if not applicable.

user.title: Add PV Array
user.description: Configure a PV array. For DC-coupled arrays (panels directly on battery inverter), enable the DC-coupled option.

data.name: Name (optional)
data.efficiency_factor: System efficiency (0-1, accounts for shading, wiring, soiling)

data_description.peak_power_kwp: Total rated peak power of all panels in this array
data_description.efficiency_factor: Ignored for DC-coupled arrays (uses DC coupling efficiency from main config)
data_description.pv_forecast_sensors: Forecast sensors from a PV forecast integration such as Solcast (select both the 'Forecast Today' and 'Forecast Tomorrow' sensors). When set, their data replaces the internal radiation-based model for the periods they cover; the internal model remains the fallback.
data_description.pv_measured_production_sensor: Cumulative kWh produced by THIS array. Used to learn a per-array correction on the forecast — a wrong tilt or orientation entry, soiling or a dead string show up as a systematic gain error. Also feeds the gross-load reconstruction, alongside any sensors already configured there. If one inverter reports a single counter for several arrays, set it on one of them.

reconfigure.title: Edit PV Array
reconfigure.description: Update the configuration for this PV array.
